work_class: The project includes upgrading Aeration Basins 1 and 2 at the GLWA wastewater treatment facility. The work involves replacing two existing pumps with larger, more efficient variable-speed pumps, improving the treatment process to handle higher wet weather flows, and adding controls and hydraulic improvements to keep basin water levels more stable. The upgrades will also improve energy efficiency, reduce oxygen usage, and enhance phosphorus removal to meet environmental permit requirements. In addition, the project includes rehabilitation of the facility's structural, architectural, mechanical, piping, electrical, and instrumentation systems to extend the facility's service life by approximately 30 years and support continued compliance with GLWA discharge permits.

work_class:

Remodeling the existing attic to create a new finished dormer addition. The scope of work includes selective demolition, reframing of the roof to accommodate the new dormer extension, and structural framing to support the new dormer floor, ceiling, and walls. Remodel the existing attic bathroom with new layout and finishes. The dormer addition will create a large open finished office space with built in cabinetry, new windows, lighting, and hardwood flooring. The new windows will be factory finished wood interiors, and all of the new wood baseboards, interior casings, and doors at the addition will be stained and finished onsite to match. - At the exterior, the new dormer addition will be framed and finished with Hardie siding in the panel and batten style to recreate the traditional tudor siding finish, and a new white TPO roofing system.- The radiators at the addition will be relocated and replaced with new baseboard style radiators- The existing air conditioning system that currently serves only the second floor will be replaced and upgraded to provide air conditioning to the attic and 2nd floor in a single zone.

work_class:
The project is a partial change of use and occupancy involving the interior renovation of the existing (5) five-story building.
The first floor will remain in a mixed Business (B) and Assembly (A-3) occupancy, accommodating retail and small gathering or lounge functions with only code-required upgrades. 
The upper floors will be converted to R-2 co-living (2 dwelling units) consisting of compact guest rooms, shared amenities, and support spaces. 
Selective interior demolition, new fire-rated partitions and a rated stair enclosure, life-safety and egress upgrades, limited secondary structural modifications, and modernization of the existing elevator. 
Exterior work is limited to minor repair and painting where required; no significant changes to the building envelope are anticipated. Construction includes new partitions, doors, and built-in elements; reconfiguration of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems; new lighting and electrical distribution; and updates to the fire alarm and sprinkler systems to meet current code. 
Existing structural elements and plumbing risers will be reused where feasible. All work will occur within the existing building footprint with no expansion of the structure. The project is classified as a Level 3 alteration with a partial change of use and occupancy
Area affected: 4,696 SF.
